acceptance: tests/integration/worktree/test_batch_loop_e2e.py runs locally without a Rust toolchain.
context: Filed 2026-11-25 at the close of the run-timeout effort (umbrella run-timeout-plan-20261120, done). Evidence read that day; re-read code, docs and run folders before acting.
description:
## Problem
On 2026-11-23 `make heavy-run CMD='uv run -- python -m pytest -n0 -m "" tests/integration/worktree/test_batch_loop_e2e.py'` gave 7 errors on this Mac: the fixture runs `uv run --project _project/scripts --locked -- tractable bootstrap ...`, which tried to build `pydantic-core==2.46.5` from source and failed (`rustup could not choose a version of cargo to run`). The suite runs in CI (workflow Batch Loop E2E), so a batch-tooling change that breaks it is found only after pushing: Batch Loop E2E run 45188204632 on #4468's first head ddb1ddd32e failed in batch-member-check with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'preflight_receipt'`. Lead: `_project/scripts/uv.lock` has pydantic-core 2.46.5 macOS arm64 wheels for cp311–cp314 only; this Mac's `python3` is Homebrew 3.15.0 and the fixture repo pins no interpreter (`requires-python >=3.11`), so uv probably picks 3.15, which has no wheel [inference]. rustup is installed but has no default toolchain.

## Change
Find why `_project/scripts`' lock resolves pydantic-core to a source build on darwin-arm64 for the interpreter the fixture uses (Python version, missing wheel, `--locked` resolution), and fix it so the suite runs locally without a Rust toolchain: for example a lock that has a wheel for the local interpreter, or the fixture using the project's interpreter.

## Decision gates
- Do not install a Rust toolchain, set a rustup default, or change the global toolchain without the owner's approval.
- Do not weaken or skip the suite in CI.

## Verification rubric
Pass: before the change, `make heavy-run CMD='uv run -- python -m pytest -n0 -m "" tests/integration/worktree/test_batch_loop_e2e.py'` errors on the pydantic-core build; after it, the same command runs with 0 errors and no Rust toolchain in use, and Batch Loop E2E passes in CI.
Fail: the suite still needs a Rust toolchain locally.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Edit files with the edit tool, never by script. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers, UAT, generators at scale) only through `make heavy-run` or lock-taking entry points; never skip the lock, admission or watchdog; never delete anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. No live cloud run and no cloud credentials unless this item's Decision gates say the owner approved it in the current task. BenchBox imposes no default run limit: add none. No comments or docstrings in first-party code; one changelog fragment for a user-facing change. Never post a stand-in review, close and reopen a pull request to restart CI, use `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite an author. Arm once; a second time only after fixing the cause the refusal named. Reply on every review thread; resolve it only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise it again.
